description.value: La Baguette is an artisanal French bakery and cafe in downtown Revelstoke, founded in 2009 by chefs Sonia and Olivier, renowned for sourdough loaves slow-fermented and baked in a stone oven alongside handcrafted Viennoiserie. The menu spans hearty breakfasts, Montreal-style bagels, gourmet sandwiches, firewood pizzas, poutine, and house-smoked meats — substantial fuel for a day in the saddle. The business has grown to include an affiliated specialty grocery store (Le Marché Gourmet) next door and a second outlet at Revelstoke Mountain Resort.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms La Baguette is an active artisanal French bakery and cafe at 607 Victoria Road unit #103, Revelstoke, matching the OSM housenumber and unit but differing slightly in street name ('Victoria Street West' vs 'Victoria Road'). Phone (250) 837-3755 matches OSM. Takeout is confirmed by 'on the go' language and online ordering; vegan/GF is confirmed by explicit mention of dairy-free, vegan, and gluten-free gelatos and sorbets. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi evidence appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Street name minor discrepancy: OSM lists 'Victoria Street West' while the website uses '607 Victoria Road unit #103'; likely the same address but cannot confirm with certainty.

The OSM record covers only the downtown La Baguette cafe; the broader labaguettecafe.ca site also covers La Petite Baguette (Revelstoke Mountain Resort) and Le Marché Gourmet — ensure no duplicate OSM records exist for those sibling locations at the same address.
